Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next_node=None): self.value, self.next = value, next_node

def traverse(head):
    values = []
    while head:
        values.append(head.value); head = head.next
    return values

head = Node(1, Node(2, Node(3)))
assert traverse(head) == [1, 2, 3]
```
explanation: Each node stores a value and a reference to the next node. Traversal takes O(n) time and O(n) output space.
